var lang = "zh-cn"; 
var realKey = key;
var lastIndex = key.lastIndexOf("@");
    if (lastIndex !== -1) {
    realKey = key.substring(0, lastIndex);  
var suffix = key.substring(lastIndex + 1);     
    if (suffix === "繁") lang = "zh-tw";
    if (suffix === "英") lang = "en";
}
result = `https://www.noveltri.com/${lang}/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(realKey)}&page={{page}}`;
result;
</js>
